word.title: Concept Header for the Concept of Brainstorm Communities

conceptHeader.description: A self-curating, leaderless online community on nostr. Each user maintains a personal record of the community (metadata + engine config). Membership is determined algorithmically from member-issued endorsements/vetoes via the GR Community scoring system; no single party owns or controls the community. SKELETON — schema details may evolve before v1.1.0 is activated. See feat/communities/PLAN.md §3 for design.
